payload.text: Intent's dry run and its cut need rhadamanth unlocked, with hv at the Mac, from the pre-flight through the notary submit. Intent enables devbin's macOS stage (bin/.devbin/config.yaml, macos: enabled: true), so the cut's pre-flight runs macos doctor on macOS (devbin issue 0366), and the macOS leg signs and notarises before the tag. The notarytool profile is a data-protection keychain item, readable only while the login session is unlocked (devbin-dc's finding, relayed by devbin-vc on 2026-11-25; the fix, --keychain with the login keychain file, rides devbin 0.1.34). bin/devbin preflight all runs Intent's five pre-flight checks without it.
